clock_model.rtl_boundary: clk_i rising edge advances one complete E cycle when clock_enable_i is high
clock_model.historical_boundary: HD63705V0 derives E by dividing its oscillator by four; E clocks the CPU and primary timer
clock_model.limitation: Oscillator analog behavior, output pad delay, setup/hold, STOP recovery delay, TIMER/VPP voltage thresholds, and EPROM programming pulse width are outside the normalized boundary

signals.name: clk_i
signals.fact: one rising edge advances one normalized E cycle

signals.name: clock_enable_i
signals.fact: low preserves all synchronous state

signals.name: reset_n_i
signals.fact: active-low asynchronous digital reset boundary

signals.name: standby_n_i
signals.fact: low resets internal registers, holds the CPU reset, retains RAM, and makes GPIO high impedance

signals.name: int_n_i
signals.fact: active-low edge or edge-and-level external interrupt selected by MR5

signals.name: int2_n_i
signals.fact: active-low falling-edge interrupt input; integration connects it to the shared D6 pin level

signals.name: timer_i
signals.fact: timer gate or rising-edge event input during MCU mode

signals.name: port_a_i
signals.fact: physical input levels

signals.name: port_a_o
signals.fact: output latch

signals.name: port_a_oe_o
signals.fact: one enables the corresponding output driver

signals.name: port_b_i
signals.fact: physical input levels

signals.name: port_b_o
signals.fact: output latch

signals.name: port_b_oe_o
signals.fact: one enables the corresponding output driver

signals.name: port_c_i
signals.fact: physical input levels

signals.name: port_c_o
signals.fact: output latch

signals.name: port_c_oe_o
signals.fact: one enables the corresponding output driver

signals.name: port_d_i
signals.fact: seven physical GPIO/SCI levels; D6 is paired with int2_n_i by the integration

signals.name: port_d_o
signals.fact: seven-bit latch with Tx and internal CK overrides

signals.name: port_d_oe_o
signals.fact: seven output enables with SCI overrides

signals.name: program_address_o
signals.fact: fourteen-bit MCU address or 1000 plus the twelve-bit programming address

signals.name: program_read_o
signals.fact: active for MCU reads in 1000-1FFF, ordinary +5-V EPROM reads with CE/OE low, or VPP verification with OE low and CE don't-care

signals.name: program_data_i
signals.fact: byte supplied by FPGA firmware storage

signals.name: eprom_mode_i
signals.fact: selects the normalized EPROM programming interface and holds MCU logic reset

signals.name: eprom_address_i
signals.fact: twelve-bit EPROM offset

signals.name: eprom_data_i
signals.fact: byte presented for programming

signals.name: eprom_data_o
signals.fact: byte returned by FPGA firmware storage

signals.name: eprom_data_oe_o
signals.fact: active for a qualified ordinary read or VPP verification

signals.name: eprom_chip_enable_n_i
signals.fact: low qualifies ordinary reads and programming; verification treats it as don't-care

signals.name: eprom_output_enable_n_i
signals.fact: low selects read/verification; high selects programming or output disable according to voltage and CE

signals.name: eprom_read_voltage_i
signals.fact: digital indication of the ordinary-read voltage state; voltage magnitude is not modeled

signals.name: eprom_program_voltage_i
signals.fact: digital indication that documented programming voltage is present; no analog voltage is modeled

signals.name: eprom_program_data_o
signals.fact: byte forwarded to the FPGA EPROM-storage owner

signals.name: eprom_program_o
signals.historical: CE low, OE high, VPP present
signals.fact: digital program request to the external storage owner

signals.name: sci_tx_o
signals.fact: synchronous least-significant-bit-first transmit level

signals.name: sci_clock_o
signals.fact: internal transfer-clock level

halt_interrupt_behavior: WAIT leaves peripherals running and uses the dedicated timer vector when timer wakes it. STOP halts peripherals and accepts only INT or enabled INT2; normalized timer/SCI field changes follow figure 2-18, while conflicting section 2.9 prose and table 2-5 leave exact silicon register retention UNDEFINED_BY_DOCUMENTATION.
